function graph3d:Char2path3d(char,sc,plane,dir) --text converted into 3d paths in a plane
-- sc = scale number or table {scalex, scaley}
-- char will be centered on A in the plane={A,n}
-- dir is a vector in the plane (direction of writing)
    local scx, scy
    if type(sc) == "number" then 
        scx = sc; scy = sc
    else
        scx, scy = table.unpack(sc)
    end
    local x1,x2,y1,y2 = table.unpack(char.bb)
    local c = Z((x1+x2)/2,(y1+y2)/2)
    local A, n = table.unpack(plane)
    n = pt3d.normalize(n)
    local u = pt3d.normalize(dir)
    local v = pt3d.prod(n,u)
    local mat = {-c,Z(1,0),cpx.I} 
    local C = mtransform(char.path,mat)
    local C3d = {}
    for _,z in ipairs(C) do
        if type(z) ~= "string" then table.insert(C3d, A+scx*z.re*u+scy*z.im*v)
        else table.insert(C3d,z)
        end
    end
    return C3d
end

function splitLongSeg(L) -- to divide segments that are too long
    -- L is a list of list of 3d points
    local ret, cp, B, A = {}
    for _, lg in ipairs(L) do
        B = lg[1]; cp = {}
        for k = 2, #lg do
            A = B; B = lg[k]
            local len = pt3d.abs(B-A)
            local nb = math.floor(10*len)
            insert(cp, linspace(A,B,nb+2) )
        end
        table.insert(ret,cp)
    end
    return ret
end

function conv2path(L) -- conversion list of list of 3d points (L) -> path
    local ret = {} 
    for _, cp in ipairs(L) do
        table.insert(cp,2,"m") -- move
        table.insert(cp,"l")  -- lineto
        insert(ret,cp)
    end
    return ret
end

function curve_on_cylinder(curve,cylinder,screenNormal) --to separate the visible part from the hidden part of the curve
-- curve is a 3d polyline on a cylinder,
-- cylinder = {A,r,B}
    local A,r,B = table.unpack(cylinder)
    local U = B-A
    local visible_function = function(N)
        local I = dproj3d(N,{A,U})
        return (pt3d.dot(N-I,screenNormal) >= 0)
    end
    return split_points_by_visibility(curve,visible_function)
end
\end{luacode*}


\begin{luadraw}{name=cylinder_text}
local g = graph3d:new{viewdir={40,60}}
local A, r, B = -3*vecK, 2, 2.5*vecK -- cylinder

local f = function(A) return Mc(r,A.y/r,A.z) end -- image of a point A on the cylinder by winding

local C = g:Char2path3d(example,4,{r*vecI,vecI},vecJ)
-- C is the text converted into 3d paths, in the plane passing through M(r,0,0) and orthogonal to vecI=M(1,0,0), the direction of writing is given by the vector vecJ=M(0,1,0), with a scale of 12.
C = path3d(C) -- conversion path -> list of list of 3d points
C = splitLongSeg(C) -- to divide segments that are too long
C = ftransform3d(C,f) -- plane curve -> cylindrical curve transformation

local draw = function()
    local Cv, Ch = curve_on_cylinder(C, {A,r,B}, g.Normal) -- visible part and hidden part of C
    Ch = conv2path(Ch) -- hidden part, conversion to path
    g:Dpath3d(Ch, "line width=0.8pt,fill=red") -- hidden part first
    g:Dcylinder(A,r,B,{color="blue",opacity=0.8}) -- cylinder
    Cv = conv2path(Cv) -- visible part, conversion to path
    g:Dpath3d(Cv, "line width=0.8pt,fill=red")
end

-- now we can draw :
g:Shift(-3+1.5*cpx.I); draw(); g:IDmatrix()

-- again
g:Shift(3-1.5*cpx.I); g:Setviewdir(-30,15); draw(); g:IDmatrix()
g:Show()
\end{luadraw}
\end{document}
